verdict.line: You lose if you keep trading into her E (Hookshot) + empowered Q combo through levels 3-6; you win if you out-stack her Q (Siphoning Strike) into a scaled Fury of the Sands (R) by mid game.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire early kit is built to control when a fight happens: E (Hookshot) picks the engage range, Q (Precision Protocol) rewards a delayed recast with big bonus damage, and W (Tactical Sweep) pokes and heals her back up. Nasus has no way to contest that initiative before level 6, so the 47.5% win rate over 99 games and Camille's lane/solo-kill edge are real — but Nasus doesn't need to win trades, he needs Q stacks and time, and Fury of the Sands (R) at 120s cooldown is the equalizer the data doesn't capture directly.

theirWindow.what: She can knock you up with E (800 range, requires a wall), land, and chain an empowered Q auto plus W cone for a full combo. Don't stand in minion-wave range of a wall she can jump off, and respect that W (Tactical Sweep) heals her on the outer-half hit.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap-closer and no knockup, so this is when you plant E (Spirit Fire, 650 range) on the wave and freely stack Q (Siphoning Strike) in melee without eating a surprise engage.

start.why: Doran's Shield's regen and poke-reduction directly counters her Q/W harass pattern (49.4% win rate, 74.2% pick) while you farm Q stacks.

boots.why: Camille's trade pattern leans on basic attacks (her empowered Q auto, her on-hit passive shield) — flat reduction on those hits outperforms the Lucidity path here (53.8% win rate over 52 games).

core.why: The most-picked, highest-win-rate path (62.5% over 16 games) — gives you the move speed and burst to actually catch her once you're stacked.
Attack speed slow punishes her Hookshot-engage-then-kite pattern and softens her physical damage.
Stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal to win extended trades once Q stacks are online.

situational.when: she's building into extended auto-trades and leaning on W's healing to sustain lane
you want the wave-clear and slow proc to punish her for walking up without Hookshot
you're ahead on stacks and want to snowball damage faster than the defensive path

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain-and-kite healing on movement directly answers her short-trade, disengage-after-E playstyle, and it's the highest-pick page in the data (54.2% pick, 47.7% win rate).

summoners.why: Ghost lets you disengage or close distance without eating a Hookshot punish, and Teleport resets you to lane after she forces you off with poke — it's the most-played combo in the data (57.9% pick, 44.3% win rate).

playing.title: Don't trade near walls
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot, 800 range) only works off a wall — if you're farming near one in levels 3-6, you're inviting the knockup-into-combo. Pull the wave away from walls when her E is up.

playing.title: Save W for her retreat, not her engage
playing.detail: Wither decelerates movement and attack speed over time rather than stopping her instantly, so it's weak as a panic button mid-combo but strong for denying her Hookshot-away escape or her kiting after a poke.

playing.title: Zone with Spirit Fire instead of melee trading
playing.detail: E (Spirit Fire, 650 range) shreds armor on the zone — drop it on the wave and let her choose between losing CS or taking the hit, instead of walking into her empowered Q auto range.

playing.title: Track her R cooldown after level 6
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum sits at 140/115/90s — once she whiffs or uses it, you get a long window where her all-in threat drops sharply. Push Q stacks and contest harder during that window.

playing.title: Stack over styling
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike's cooldown drops to 4s at max rank and every stack is permanent power — prioritize safe Q resets on minions over cosmetic trades you're likely to lose early.

playing.title: Let Fury of the Sands decide fights from 6 onward
playing.detail: R's health drain and range boost flips trades Camille would otherwise win clean — don't engage seriously below level 6, but don't fear it once it's up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are this brief's own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: It is important to avoid Camille’s (E) ability. Focus foremost on raising your [Q] stacks, and use Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R] to counterplay when Camille’s abilities are on cooldown to gain lane control.
